The immutable WaterIncident model now checks monotonic event history, complete assessment-to-event binding, severity consistency, and matching acknowledgement/closure audit events; new assessments cannot be backdated before the last event, while identical acknowledgement replay remains idempotent. data_needs: შენახული synthetic input hashes და სრული benchmark protocol
დამოუკიდებელი runtime-ების raw report-ები და არტეფაქტების SHA-256
შემდეგ ეტაპზე native C/OpenMP ან სხვა runtime-ის იდენტურ input-ზე შედარება
risks: Hosted runner-ების CPU მოდელი, virtualization და host contention იცვლება
synthetic cancellation workload რეალურ სამეცნიერო workload-ს არ წარმოადგენს
tracemalloc არ ზომავს სრულ RSS-ს ან ყველა native allocation-ს
სამი repetition timing-ის მაღალი სიმძლავრის სტატისტიკურ დასკვნას არ იძლევა
blockers: Native C/OpenMP evidence is from one hosted x86-64 runner; independent native hardware replication is not complete.
Five repetitions and synthetic cancellation fixtures do not establish general accuracy or performance.
streams.status_detail: PR #30 merged into main at 8bb91db62105a83391986d06e88f198b5c7d1670. Exact-head quality CI passed 264 Python tests; native OpenMP CI passed 20 cases with actual 1/2/4/8 worker counts; GIL-enabled and free-threaded CPU-thread jobs passed. The archived raw report and frozen summary are now in data/noema-005/; the validator reproduces all sample medians, CPU/wall ratios and speedups, compares summary-to-raw cases, and verifies the C source SHA-256 and archived Git blob SHA-1. On one Ubuntu 24.04 x86-64/GCC 13.3 runner, Neumaier-state was exact in 5/5 runs per case and naive methods 0/5; observed median speedups ranged 0.999x–3.614x and are run-sensitive. The historical local 10/20-case report is explicitly invalidated.
streams.next_step: Compare pairwise-tree, long-double and binned/exact accumulators; add an input-buffer/memory-bandwidth workload; repeat native OpenMP on independent ARM64 and x86-64 hardware with preregistered repetitions; obtain independent numerical-method review.
success_metrics: exact-reference accuracy თითოეული მეთოდისა და runtime-ის მიხედვით
median wall-time და uncertainty interval წინასწარ განსაზღვრული repetition protocol-ით

streams.human_benefit: კვლევის ისტორიისა და სამუშაოების დაკარგვის რისკის შემცირება და შედეგების წარმომავლობის შენარჩუნება.
streams.hypothesis: SQLite file header-ის journal-version-ის პირდაპირი შემოწმება immutable read-only validation-თან ერთად სწორად უარყოფს WAL-mode backup-ს ისე, რომ source file არ შეიცვალოს.
methodology: SQLite official file-format და WAL documentation-ის მიხედვით file header-ის byte 18/19 შემოწმება
synthetic database backup/restore round-trip, WAL-mode negative case, tampered audit და no-overwrite regression tests
GitHub Actions-ის exact-head CI და mergeability verification
შემდგომ ეტაპზე encrypted off-host backup, retention/rotation და scheduled restore drills

sources.title: SQLite Database File Format
Write-Ahead Logging
NOEMA operational observability and verified SQLite backup PR

data_needs: synthetic SQLite databases with rollback-journal and WAL header states
backup/restore test fixtures and immutable source hash
CI job logs and exact commit SHA
risks: immutable=1 SQLite connection may mask the stored WAL journal mode
same-host backup does not protect against host/disk loss
backup is currently unencrypted and has no off-host retention automation
audit hash chain without signed external checkpoint does not prevent all tampering scenarios
blockers: PR #19 is 32 commits ahead / 49 behind current main and mergeable=false; a careful merge/rebase and new exact-head CI are required.
Backups are not encrypted or stored off-host; retention/rotation and scheduled restore drills are not implemented.
streams.status_detail: PR #19 remains an older, divergent backup/observability branch. Against current main it is 32 commits ahead / 49 behind and mergeable=false. Its earlier WAL-header/backup-restore CI is not current-main merge evidence. Backups remain local and unencrypted; off-host retention and scheduled restore drills are not implemented.
streams.next_step: Carefully refresh PR #19 onto current main without losing its existing backup/observability work; rerun exact-head quality checks and a restore drill. Then implement encrypted off-host backup, retention/rotation, integrity verification and scheduled restore exercises.
success_metrics: restore rejects WAL-mode header and corrupted audit data before destination creation
restore never overwrites an existing destination and does not mutate source bytes
complete unit tests, frozen research reproductions, site build and publication-boundary checks pass
restore drill and encrypted off-host backup policy are documented and later independently tested
